data.title: Cart sessions show inconsistent state after cache schema migration
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: The incident ticket contains no confirmed root cause.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Check cache eviction and TTL settings to ensure stale entries are not persisting', success_signal='Cache TTLs are correctly configured and no entries older than the success rate', success_signal='Checkout success rate returns to >=99% and p95 latency <=800ms within the rollout window.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='Implement automated schema validation checks for future cache migrations', success_signal='CI pipeline now fails if cache schema changes are not accompanied by service compatibility tests.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Document findings and update runbooks for cache schema migration procedures', success_signal='Runbook updated and reviewed by SRE and development teams.', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The incident involves checkout errors and reduced success rate after a cache schema migration. The payment-service is suspected but no root cause is confirmed. Inconsistent session state is a common symptom of schema drift between cache and application. The objective is to restore checkout success and performance, so the investigation must verify whether the migration altered the session schema, whether the payment-service is still compatible, and whether any stale cache entries are causing failures.')
